title: The tire offer marked on a tool handle
body: A rubber band holds a service slip to the screwdriver. Four circles are drawn beside one wheel sketch; only the outer groove is filled with dark dust.
rival_reading: A road crew could inspect tires after a closure and keep a service slip with its tools; the dust does not identify where it came from.
gloss: A tire drawing and dark groove residue accompany a repair tool.

title: The service receipt for the unreturned wheel
body: Four tires are listed on the receipt. Three grease circles appear on the reverse; a small note asks that the smoothest one be saved for a child's bicycle.
rival_reading: A farm delivery or ordinary repair could account for a missing tire mark; the receipt does not say that officials concealed an accident.
gloss: A tire receipt has one unmatched mark and a private request.

cites.quote: Show this flyer at our outlet
